description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the Thunder project, including a template class for logging control types, external functions for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging categories and messages.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class managing logging control types, providing methods to check if logging is enabled, enable/disable logging, and access metadata.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Triggers the IsEnabled check, possibly for initialization or announcement purposes.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Control type associated with the logging category.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is currently enabled.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables logging based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata associated with the logging control.
